title: Einstein form is a selection result and does not fix $G$

statements.text: The Einstein equation is selected under stated conditions and is not a consequence of continuity alone. The selection does not derive the value of $G$, the microscopic origin of matter stress, or a quantum theory of geometry.

sources.quote: It is not strong enough, by itself, to derive the numerical value of G, the microscopic origin of matter stress, or a quantum theory of geometry.
The coupling normalisation is not fixed by continuity or by the binary 7 × 7 derivation lattice.
